link_analysis.models: every model that is gate-valid in the base condition AND has structured-format matrix aggregates (n = number of such models)
link_analysis.x: H8 lookahead_use_rate (per character); secondary x = lookahead_use_rate - ignore_baseline_rate
y: combat score = mean win_rate x min(1, hp_ratio), structured, 5-seed aggregate (as pre-specified in the base protocol; NOTE: equals 1.0 for every eligible model in the matrix -> reported as tied/undefined)
combat avg_hp_ratio (unclipped), structured, 5-seed aggregate - added because of that ceiling, decided from the matrix y-distribution only, before any correlation was computed
run avg_progress, structured, 5-seed aggregate (run-level between-model variance share ~.02: expected uninformative)
turn avg_damage_ratio, structured, 5-seed aggregate (single-turn decision quality; descriptive)
link_analysis.test: Spearman rank correlation per character, exact permutation p over all n! orderings; descriptive/directional only
link_analysis.power_note: with n=4 the smallest attainable two-sided exact p is 2/24 = .083 (cannot reach .05); n=5 gives 2/120 = .017
